_comment: GitHub repository ruleset (ADR 0012) — server-side enforcement for repos that adopt project-bootstrap. Rulesets are server-side, aggregate across rules ('most restrictive wins'), and carry an explicit bypass_actors list (default empty = nobody bypasses, including admins — closes 穴 2). Apply with: gh api -X POST repos/OWNER/REPO/rulesets --input templates/github/ruleset.json . Prefer this over the REST branch-protection endpoint when rolling out across many repos.
name: verification-gate
